hall-cpa.offering: Hall CPA’s website lists tax advisory, tax preparation, accounting, cost segregation, and tax resolution for real estate investors and related businesses.
hall-cpa.implementation: The service menu includes both study work and tax preparation. Request the study, return, entity, and investor-reporting responsibilities in the actual proposal.
hall-cpa.decision: A landlord, developer, and syndicator need different accounting and reporting scopes. Compare the same ownership structure and deliverables before comparing fees.
hall-cpa.correction: Removed unsupported assumptions that a real estate planning engagement nearly always requires a study, along with unverified service and turnaround comparisons.

wcg-cpas.offering: WCG publishes business advisory packages with annual fees paid through monthly subscriptions. Its service menu also includes tax preparation, accounting, entity support, and planning.
wcg-cpas.implementation: The package selected determines which returns, accounting work, and advisory access are included. Identify rental activity and additional entities separately.
wcg-cpas.decision: An annual package can cover continuing work that a defined advisory engagement does not. Compare included returns and recurring deliverables rather than the payment amount alone.
wcg-cpas.correction: Replaced reputation claims and unsupported capability rankings with the published package model and scope questions.

dark-horse-cpas.offering: Dark Horse’s official site lists business and personal tax services, bookkeeping, outsourced accounting, fractional CFO work, and private wealth services.
dark-horse-cpas.implementation: Those are separate service lines. Ask who performs the work, who reviews it, and whether the agreement covers the business, household, or both.
dark-horse-cpas.decision: Compare a broader accounting relationship with the specific planning project you need. Staffing arrangements and service inclusion should come from the engagement letter.
dark-horse-cpas.correction: Removed the unverified claim that work is never passed to junior staff and unsupported income cutoffs for choosing AE.

proactive-tax-advisors.offering: Proactive Tax Advisors describes a tax strategy framework combining entity structure, income flow, timing, deductions, and credits for service-business owners and real estate investors.
proactive-tax-advisors.implementation: Its process describes a strategy system and an option for ongoing advisory. Confirm implementation tasks, preparation responsibility, and continuing fees directly.
proactive-tax-advisors.decision: Build the comparison around the decisions to be made and the support period. Advertised tax reductions are marketing claims, not verified outcomes for your situation.
proactive-tax-advisors.correction: Removed unsupported binary capability scores, financial-fit cutoffs, and implied guarantees.

cssi.offering: CSSI’s official service page describes engineering-based cost segregation, R&D tax credits, and Section 179D work for property owners and businesses.
cssi.implementation: Price the specific specialty project. Ask who delivers the final schedules, responds to preparer questions, and handles any separately contracted filing work.
cssi.decision: A specialty incentive project and an owner-level planning engagement may be complementary. Compare the cost and responsibility for each workstream.
cssi.correction: Replaced generalizations about a study provider’s limitations with its published service lines.

capstan-tax-strategies.offering: Capstan’s official menu includes cost segregation, R&D credits, energy incentives, unit-of-property and tangible-property analysis, and consulting.
capstan-tax-strategies.implementation: Ask which technical analysis is needed, what documentation is delivered, and how the specialty team coordinates with your accountant.
capstan-tax-strategies.decision: A project involving building components, repairs, or energy incentives may require a specialty scope beyond a general planning engagement.
capstan-tax-strategies.correction: Removed unsupported no-service marks and comparative turnaround promises.

cost-seg-smart.offering: Cost Seg Smart advertises engineering-based studies, CPA coordination, twelve months of revisions, and written audit support. Its homepage says Form 3115 preparation is available separately.
cost-seg-smart.implementation: Request separate prices for the study and Form 3115 preparation, and confirm who prepares the income tax return and evaluates the owner’s overall position.
cost-seg-smart.decision: The published starting study price is not a complete advisory or filing package. The right comparison includes the report, any method-change work, and the actual preparer handoff.
cost-seg-smart.correction: Corrected the false statement that Form 3115 preparation is unavailable and removed assumptions based solely on software delivery.

engineered-tax-services.offering: Engineered Tax Services lists cost segregation, R&D credits, energy deductions, incentive reports, and 1031 exchange services on its official website.
engineered-tax-services.implementation: Identify the specialty project and the professional coordinating it with the return preparer. A broad menu does not establish that every listed service is bundled.
engineered-tax-services.decision: Separate building analysis, specialty incentives, and household or business-owner advisory in both proposals.
engineered-tax-services.correction: Removed blanket report-only descriptions and unrelated tax conclusions.

kbkg.offering: KBKG’s website lists specialty work across cost segregation, R&D credits, energy incentives, and fixed-asset reviews. It also offers CostSegregation.com as a separate software workflow.
kbkg.implementation: Distinguish the self-guided product from a professional engineering engagement. Confirm review, report support, and the accountant’s reporting responsibilities for the selected path.
kbkg.decision: Compare professional services with professional services and software with software. The lowest software price does not establish the price of KBKG’s full-service engineering work.
kbkg.correction: Removed unsupported weeks-versus-days comparisons, universal report-only assertions, and unverified relative-price claims.

madison-specs.offering: Madison SPECS describes a feasibility analysis, an engineer’s on-site property tour, and a cost segregation report developed in coordination with the client’s CPA.
madison-specs.implementation: Its published process sends the report to the client’s CPA for the income tax return. Confirm any additional services and audit-response terms in the proposal.
madison-specs.decision: An owner who wants to keep an existing CPA should compare the report handoff, property visit, and follow-up support with a separately scoped AE study.
madison-specs.correction: Replaced claims that the firm offers no advisory or related services with its published CPA-coordination process.

re-cost-seg.offering: R.E. Cost Seg lists Fully Engineered Studies, Rapid Reports, and Form 3115 Preparation. It describes coordination with the client’s CPA and delivery of fixed-asset schedules.
re-cost-seg.implementation: Choose the study path for the property, then confirm the separate Form 3115 scope, report corrections, and income-tax return responsibility.
re-cost-seg.decision: Rapid Reports and fully engineered studies have different eligibility and inspection requirements. Compare the same property and review level before comparing prices.
re-cost-seg.correction: Corrected the false claim that R.E. Cost Seg does not prepare Form 3115 and removed unsupported report-only and reputation claims.

cherry-bekaert.offering: Cherry Bekaert presents accounting, tax, audit, and advisory services across multiple industries on its official website.
cherry-bekaert.implementation: Ask which company, owner, assurance, and specialist teams the engagement requires, and which deliverables and fees belong to each.
cherry-bekaert.decision: A multi-service company engagement can contain work beyond AE’s standard owner advisory. Compare the equivalent workstream without treating the whole firm as a study provider.
cherry-bekaert.correction: Removed a template that incorrectly framed a broad accounting firm as a study-only alternative.

deloitte-tax.offering: Deloitte’s U.S. services site lists direct and indirect tax, global employer services, tax transformation, and other consulting and assurance disciplines.
deloitte-tax.implementation: Define the actual workstream, countries, entities, specialists, and ongoing obligations. A large multidisciplinary engagement and an owner advisory project need different scopes.
deloitte-tax.decision: Compare AE against the owner-level assignment it agrees to perform. Retain separately contracted specialists for work outside that scope.
deloitte-tax.correction: Removed study-only framing and unsupported universal scale or capability claims.

kpmg.offering: KPMG’s U.S. site presents tax, audit and assurance, advisory, and private-company services within a multidisciplinary firm.
kpmg.implementation: Identify which tax team, private-client work, specialist project, or assurance engagement is actually needed. Confirm separate fees and delivery responsibility.
kpmg.decision: A national-firm proposal may address needs outside a focused AE planning engagement. Compare matched assignments rather than assigning one general winner.
kpmg.correction: Removed study-provider framing from a comparison with a multidisciplinary accounting firm.

advise-re.offering: Advise RE describes real estate tax advisory and preparation, construction advisory, and buyer advisory, with a Los Angeles focus and service for investors elsewhere.
advise-re.implementation: Separate an acquisition review or construction assignment from annual returns and owner-level planning. Ask who models the transaction and who implements the recommendations.
advise-re.decision: Property development and pre-acquisition work can require a different engagement from an established rental portfolio’s annual tax review.
advise-re.correction: Removed unsupported comparative engineering fees, superlatives, and broad claims about deduction availability.

cost-segregation-authority.offering: The current CSA Partners website describes engineering-based cost segregation, property-specific documentation, site verification, audit support, and coordination with CPA and real estate clients.
cost-segregation-authority.implementation: Ask which professional handles report delivery, accountant questions, any accounting-method change, and return preparation. Use the written engagement to establish each responsibility.
cost-segregation-authority.decision: Compare a specific engineering project with AE’s separately priced study and any additional advisory or filing work. Do not infer a service is unavailable because it is absent from a summary.
cost-segregation-authority.correction: Removed unsupported study-only limitations and replaced them with the current official service description.
